table.CARD_CAL_OCCURRENCE_CANCEL: Code cancels only this one occurrence after your approval, and nothing else. Whether a cancelled occurrence can be restored has not been verified yet.
table.CARD_CAL_OCCURRENCE_CANCEL_OUTLOOK: Code cancels only this one occurrence after your approval, and nothing else. Outlook moves it to Deleted Items; whether it can be restored from there has not been verified yet.
table.CARD_CAL_OCCURRENCE_STAYS: The rest of the series stays as it is.
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_DAILY: Repeats: every day, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_NOTE: To change the series, use the calendar app; to cancel the whole series, ask here.
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_FR: Repeats: every Friday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_MO: Repeats: every Monday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_SA: Repeats: every Saturday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_SU: Repeats: every Sunday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_TH: Repeats: every Thursday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_TU: Repeats: every Tuesday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_REPEAT_WEEKLY_WE: Repeats: every Wednesday, no end date
table.CARD_CAL_SERIES_CANCEL: Code cancels the whole series after your approval: every occurrence leaves the calendar. Google is expected to move it to the calendar's trash, where you can restore it for 30 days (Google Calendar, Trash); this has not been verified yet.
table.CARD_CAL_SERIES_CANCEL_OUTLOOK: Code cancels the whole series after your approval: every occurrence leaves the calendar. Outlook moves it to Deleted Items; whether it can be restored from there has not been verified yet.
table.OUT_CAL_CANCEL_OCCURRENCE: That one occurrence is cancelled ({service}); the series stays.
table.RECUR_ASK_DATE: Which day? Say it like “cancel only {title} on {example}”.
table.RECUR_CANCEL_NOT_SIMPLE: I can only cancel a series that repeats every day or every week with no end, that you organize and that has no other guests. This one is not like that: use the calendar app.
table.RECUR_CHANGE_REFUSED: I can't change an event that repeats yet. You can change the series in the calendar app, or ask me to cancel the whole series.
table.RECUR_FOUND_OCCURRENCE: I found {title}, {when}, which repeats {rule}. Is this the one?
table.RECUR_FOUND_SERIES: I found the series {title}, {rule}. Is this the one?
table.RECUR_NOT_READ: I can't create events that repeat like that yet. I can do every day or every week, for example “every Monday at 7am”.
table.RECUR_OCCURRENCE_PAST: That occurrence of {title} has already started, so there is nothing to cancel.
table.RECUR_WHICH: {title} repeats {rule}. Do you want to cancel just one time (say “cancel only {title} on {example}”) or the whole series (say “cancel the whole series {title}”)?
table.RECUR_WHICH_DAY: {title} happens more than once in that period: {days}. Say which day, for example “cancel only {title} on {example}”.
